author: Spoookeh
body:
Hello

An idea originally created by Tazz and BmB 2 years ago, the 'All-Star Game' puts some of the server's best players against each other in various gamemodes and matches to see who will come out on top. 

When?
Saturday 19th August, 7pm BST / 2pm EST

What maps?
CTW - Sea Port
DTM - Rendezvous Champions
KoTH - Draxel

Who will be playing?
Seen as this is a community event, you can decide! Fill out this google form and players with the most votes in specific positions will be chosen to play if they can make it - https://goo.gl/forms/Ci4oBF8bTyOqBevt1  Each team will have 9 chosen players plus 1 pre-chosen captain allowing for people to sub in and out where necessary. 

Will there be a stream and referees?
I'm looking for 1 streamer (good quality) and 2 referees, please contact be on discord if you are interested - Spookeh#7166

See you next weekend!

TEAMS:

Team Banjo
Buw (Chosen leader), Maraka (7), Tomqss (5), Spyrovic (6), Joyful (4), DeltaDragon222 (5), Seuthy (6), Zegita (5), FLIMBI (9), Rememes (5)

Team AdamChen
AdamChen (Chosen leader), Mylk (6), Bleeple (5), Zeusy (5), ImRaging (7), Loo (6), Rau1 (5), InLoc (15 nice spam XD), Tazz (6),

replies.body:
ggwp was fun to watch. Banjo won Sea Port 2-0 followed by Foundry and Actrix. We played RendezvousChampions afterwards for fun and AdamChen won 2-1. 

Thanks to everyone who played, these were the rosters in the end:

Buw, DeltaDragon222, FLIMBI, Joyful, Rememes, Maraka, Seuthy, Spyrovic, Tomqss
vs
AdamChen, Melynlas, Mench, ImRaging, Rau1, InLoc, Mylk, Loo, Zeusy

If we do this again it'll be slightly  better organised and most likely on a private server. Gonna lock this post now...
